checks.name: Frozen answer files and original S3 Japanese reference retain their hashes
All 579 targets, 11 exclusions and 5 scope-negative images remain represented
Source-based semantic segmentation preserves dialogue windows and separates menu/grid items
Only explicit truncations and pure name/value identities use legal raw retention
Independent Chinese expectations preserve numeric strings, leading zeros and displayed symbols
Move-name digits are not confused with current PP or HP values
Layout projection never merges distinct numeric chunks or normalizes unknown glyphs
Static probe requires complete Japanese values and does not predict a future prefix
Conflicting normalized sources and unknown game keep all candidates without selecting the first
Equal outputs retain duplicate provenance rather than discarding sources
A static numeric example cannot leak a previous value into a new input
Every available translation is supported by the formal pack, not a candidate or expected answer
Output-bound semantic review accepts synonyms without changing the frozen answer
Missing Chinese remains in the denominator and 100 percent on published items cannot pass coverage
Unexecuted pipeline, numeric binding and real-time behavior are not mislabeled as passed
Supplemental contexts, slots, versions and observed-only semantic windows are retained
Acceptance artifacts match their recorded resource and implementation hashes
Re-running the gate is deterministic and exits with failure for the incomplete library

distinction: Harness and evidence checks pass; the Chinese library coverage acceptance fails.
